title: 第九章 再见金雅第十章 夜探严家
content_zh:
“罗冠少爷好样的！”
“严家，真是卑鄙无耻！”
护卫纷纷开口。
罗宁又惊又喜，“罗冠，今天多亏你，不然麻烦大了！”
许清清神情复杂。
罗冠道：“罗宁哥，你们先送许泰供奉回去。”他压低声音，“严家与清江帮意图不轨，速将此事告知家主！”
说完，他匆匆离开。
罗宁瞪眼，追问却已找不到罗冠身影，想到他的话心头一紧。
“走，马上回家！”
……
金鼎拍卖行。
一名下属正详细回禀，发生在青瓦街之事。
“罗冠……”
金雅默念这名字。
三次聚骨失败的少年，经天火渊后，不仅一举凝聚通天骨，更将严都玩弄于鼓掌之间。再加上之前调查结果，她心中已有决断——就是他！
拜入那位前辈门下，罗冠未来不可限量，如今便像是一块，浅埋泥沙里的黄金，趁他还未崭露头角，定要设法与之交好。
可是，该从哪着手呢？
金雅暗感苦恼时，罗冠已来到金鼎拍卖行外。
玄龟道：“小子，你当初故意留下信息，是料到了今日？”
“未雨绸缪而已。”罗冠感叹，“弟子也没想到，这么快便用上了。”

“你这么有信心，她会帮你？”
罗冠微笑，“弟子是对老师您有信心啊。”
进拍卖行询问后，他找到一名刘姓管事，“劳烦通禀，罗家罗冠请见金掌柜。”
“罗公子可有预约？”
罗冠摇头，“我有要事。”
刘管事面无表情，“没预约的话，罗公子请改日再来。”
拍卖场金雅露面后，美名一夜遍传江宁，最近登门求见者数不胜数，理由五花八门。他见怪不怪只觉可笑——区区一罗家小辈，也敢打小姐的主意？！
罗冠皱眉，以金雅的聪明，得到信息后定会调查，看来此人并非亲信，不知晓关于他的事。
“你只管通禀，金雅自会见我。”
刘管事脸一沉，“请您顾及体面！”
“来人，送罗公子出去。”
四名护卫应声而来。
人群嗤笑。
“罗家处境不妙，这小子竟还敢来金鼎撒野，真是不知所谓。”
“金雅小姐出身高贵，不少大人物都碰了钉子，也是他配惦记的？”
“愚不可及！他最好乖乖走，金鼎可不会给罗家脸面！”
罗冠摇头，“这可是你自找的……”
啪——
猛地甩手，一耳光打在刘管事脸上。
“混蛋，你敢打我！”刘管事呆了一下，跳脚怒骂，“把他抓起来！”

护卫沉着脸冲来，两人抓向罗冠，只觉得眼前一花就被放倒，另外两个，也被一人一脚踹翻在地。
眨眼功夫，事情发展令人目瞪口呆。
“罗冠失心疯了！”
“敢在金鼎闹事……找死！”
“他完了！”
content_en:
"Well done, Master Luo Guan!"
"The Yan family is so despicable and shameless!"
The guards spoke one after another.
Luo Ning was surprised and happy, "Luo Guan, thanks to you today, otherwise we would be in big trouble!"
Xu Qingqing's expression was complicated.
Luo Guandao: "Brother Luo Ning, please send Xu Tai back as an offering first." He lowered his voice, "The Yan family and the Qingjiang Gang have evil intentions. Please inform the head of the family immediately!"
After saying that, he left in a hurry.
Luo Ning stared and asked, but Luo Guan could not be found. Thinking of his words, his heart tightened.
"Let's go home right now!"
…
Jinding Auction House.
A subordinate was giving a detailed report on what happened on Qingwa Street.
"Luo Guan..."
Jin Ya recited the name silently.
The young man who failed three times to gather bones, after passing through the Heavenly Fire Abyss, not only condensed the Heavenly Bones in one fell swoop, but also toyed with Yan Du. Coupled with the results of the previous investigation, she had made a decision in her mind - it was him!
After joining that senior's sect, Luo Guan's future is unlimited. Now he is like a piece of gold buried shallowly in the sand. He must try to make friends with him before he emerges.
But where to start?
When Jin Ya was secretly distressed, Luo Guan had arrived outside Jinding Auction House.
Xuangui said: "Boy, you deliberately left the message, did you expect today?"
"It's just a precautionary measure." Luo Guan sighed, "This disciple didn't expect it to be used so soon."
"Are you so confident that she will help you?"
Luo Guan smiled, "Disciple, I have confidence in you, teacher."
After asking at the auction house, he found a steward surnamed Liu, "Excuse me, Luo Guan of the Luo family would like to see shopkeeper Jin."
"Master Luo, do you have an appointment?"
Luo Guan shook his head, "I have something important."
Manager Liu had no expression on his face, "If you don't have an appointment, Mr. Luo, please come back another day."
After Jin Ya's appearance at the auction house, her reputation spread throughout Jiangning overnight. Recently, countless people have come to see her for various reasons. He was not surprised, but found it ridiculous - a mere junior from the Luo family dared to take advantage of the young lady? !
Luo Guan frowned. With Jin Ya's intelligence, he would investigate after getting the information. It seemed that this person was not a close confidant and did not know anything about him.
"Just be clear and Jin Ya will see me."
Manager Liu's face sank, "Please take care of your dignity!"
"Someone, please send Mr. Luo out."
Four guards came in response.
The crowd jeered.
"The Luo family is in a bad situation. This kid still dares to come to Jinding to act wild. I really don't know what to say."
"Miss Jin Ya is from a noble family, and many important people have fallen into trouble. Is he worthy of worrying about her?"
"It's so stupid! He'd better go away, Jin Ding won't give the Luo family face!"
Luo Guan shook his head, "You asked for this..."
Snap——
He shook his hand suddenly and slapped Manager Liu on the face.
"Asshole, you dare to hit me!" Manager Liu was stunned for a moment, jumped to his feet and yelled, "Arrest him!"
The guards rushed over with a sullen expression, and the two of them grabbed Luo Guan, but they were knocked down as soon as they saw him. The other two were also kicked to the ground by one of them.
In the blink of an eye, things developed in a shocking way.
"Luo Guan lost his mind and went crazy!"
"Dare to cause trouble in Jinding...seeking death!"
"He's finished!"
